newsitem.title: UK: Denmark's Daufas to cease operations Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Denmark's Daufas to cease operations Tuesday.

text.p: Denmark's state-owned oil marketing company Dansk Olieforsyning (Daufas) is due to close its offices for good at the end of 1996, a source at the company said on Monday.

The company bought around 1.6 million tonnes of Danish North Sea crude oil under guaranteed contracts last year and distributed a little more than this quantity of refined oil products, the source added.
The decision to close the company was taken earlier this year after large losses were sustained in paper trading activities which had been used to hedge the company's exposure to physical markets.
